<script>const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
/* TSD webOS OPT1 — camera/map workload control; flight and mission logic unchanged.
   ?tsdPerf=low forces low-power mode; ?tsdPerf=normal disables it.
   ?tsdDebug=1 opens an on-screen diagnostic window. */
const tsdPerfParams=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const tsdWebOS=/webos|web0s|smarttv|netcast|lg browser/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
const tsdLowPower=tsdPerfParams.get('tsdPerf')==='low'||
  (tsdPerfParams.get('tsdPerf')!=='normal'&&(tsdWebOS||(!tsdPerfParams.has('tsdPerf')&&typeof window.matchMedia==='function'&&window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches)));
const tsdPerformance={
  lowPower:tsdLowPower,webOS:tsdWebOS,debug:tsdPerfParams.get('tsdDebug')==='1',
  latencyProbe:tsdPerfParams.get('tsdLatency')==='1', latencyClock:null, latencyClockAt:-Infinity,
  pixelRatio:tsdLowPower?0.82:null, irFps:tsdLowPower?12:60,
  irPixels:tsdLowPower?270000:1200000,
  mapFrames:[0,0],loopFrames:0,renderFps:[0,0],loopFps:0,
  sampleAt:0,paletteLast:-Infinity,paletteFrames:0,paletteFps:0,
  lastLinkAt:-Infinity,lastTerrainAt:new WeakMap(),lastAssistAt:-Infinity,
  lastVisionResizeAt:-Infinity, hud:null
};
window.tsdPerformance=tsdPerformance;
// Older webOS (Chromium 87) does not support these later APIs.
if(typeof Object.hasOwn!=='function')Object.hasOwn=(object,key)=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object,key);
if(typeof AbortSignal!=='undefined'&&typeof AbortSignal.timeout!=='function'){
  AbortSignal.timeout=milliseconds=>{
    const controller=new AbortController();
    setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),milliseconds);
    return controller.signal;
  };
}
// Rev7b: opt-in host clock; the same host clock is burned into the transmitted composite.
function setupPerformanceDiagnostics(){
  if(tsdPerformance.latencyProbe){
    const clock=document.createElement('output');clock.id='tsdLatencyClock';
    clock.setAttribute('aria-live','off');
    clock.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:4px;right:4px;z-index:2147483601;'+
      'background:#091018;color:#fff;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid #8ad8ff;'+
      'font:600 14px monospace;pointer-events:none;';
    clock.textContent='PC UTC '+new Date().toISOString().slice(11,23);
    document.body.appendChild(clock);tsdPerformance.latencyClock=clock;
  }
  if(!tsdPerformance.debug)return;
  const hud=document.createElement('div');hud.id='tsdPerformanceHud';
  hud.setAttribute('role','status');hud.setAttribute('aria-live','off');
  hud.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:2147483600;'+
    'background:rgba(8,17,25,.90);color:#d9f6eb;border:1px solid #526e78;'+
    'border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;min-width:174px;max-width:260px;'+
    'font:12px/1.55 Arial,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-line;';
  document.body.appendChild(hud);
  tsdPerformance.hud=hud;
}
function samplePerformance(now){
  const p=tsdPerformance;
  p.loopFrames++;
  if(p.latencyClock&&now-p.latencyClockAt>=50){
    p.latencyClockAt=now;
    p.latencyClock.textContent='PC UTC '+new Date().toISOString().slice(11,23);
  }
  if(!p.sampleAt){p.sampleAt=now;return;}
  const elapsed=now-p.sampleAt;
  if(elapsed<2000)return;
  const scale=1000/elapsed;
  p.loopFps=Math.round(p.loopFrames*scale);
  p.renderFps=p.mapFrames.map(n=>Math.round(n*scale));
  p.paletteFps=Math.round(p.paletteFrames*scale);
  p.loopFrames=0;p.mapFrames=[0,0];p.paletteFrames=0;p.sampleAt=now;
  if(p.hud){
    const heap=performance.memory?.usedJSHeapSize;
    const used=Number.isFinite(heap)?Math.round(heap/1048576)+'MB':'미지원';
    p.hud.textContent='TSD · 성능 진단'+
      '\n모드: '+(p.lowPower?'webOS 경량':'일반')+
      '\n실행 루프: '+p.loopFps+'FPS'+
      '\nEO / IR 지도: '+p.renderFps.join(' / ')+'FPS'+
      '\nIR 컬러 변환: '+p.paletteFps+'FPS'+
      '\nJS 메모리: '+used+
      '\n타일 처리 중: '+terrainTileLoads.size+
      '\n?tsdPerf=low / normal';
    const relay=window.tsdEoirRelayDiagnostics;
    if(relay)p.hud.textContent+='\nQR: '+relay.mode+' · 송출 '+relay.frames+'프레임'+
      '\nJPEG: '+relay.snapshots+' / 오류 '+relay.snapshotFailures+
      '\n중계 요청 처리: '+(relay.lastPublishMs===null?'대기':relay.lastPublishMs+'ms')+
      '\n만료 캡처: '+relay.expiredCaptures+
      '\n용량 초과/축소: '+relay.oversizeFrames+' / '+relay.resizedSnapshots+
      '\n합성 경과: '+(relay.lastFrameAt===null?'대기':Math.round(now-relay.lastFrameAt)+'ms')+
      '\nJPEG 성공 경과: '+(relay.lastPublishAt===null?'대기':Math.round(now-relay.lastPublishAt)+'ms')+
      '\n입력 패킷: '+relay.inputPackets+' · 경과 '+(relay.lastInputAt===null?'대기':Math.max(0,Math.round(now-relay.lastInputAt))+'ms')+
      '\n캡처 요청: '+relay.captureRequests+' · 합성 '+relay.frames+
      '\n캡처 소요: '+(relay.lastCaptureMs===null?'대기':relay.lastCaptureMs+'ms')+
      '\nEO/IR 렌더 횟수: '+relay.renderCallbacks.join(' / ')+
      '\nJPEG 처리 중 건너뜀: '+relay.skippedBusy+
      '\nJPEG 크기: '+(relay.jpegWidth===null?'대기':relay.jpegWidth+'×'+relay.jpegHeight)+' · '+(relay.jpegBytes===null?'대기':Math.round(relay.jpegBytes/1024)+'KB')+
      '\n압축 소요: '+(relay.jpegEncodeMs===null?'대기':relay.jpegEncodeMs+'ms')+' · 적응 '+relay.adaptiveSnapshots+
      '\n직접 송출: '+(relay.directSent??'미확인')+' · RTCP 손실 '+(relay.directLost??'미확인')+' · RTT '+(relay.directRttMs??'미확인')+
      '\n영상 경로: '+(relay.forceJpeg?'JPEG 강제':'자동')+' · ?tsdVideo=jpeg'+
      '\n조종 경로: '+relay.lastInputPath+' · '+relay.inputGate+' · CH5 '+(relay.arm===null?'?':relay.arm?'ON':'OFF')+
      '\n수신 우측 R/P: '+(relay.rawAxes?relay.rawAxes.slice(0,2).map(v=>v.toFixed(2)).join(' / '):'-')+
      '\n수신 좌측 T/Y: '+(relay.rawAxes?relay.rawAxes.slice(2).map(v=>v.toFixed(2)).join(' / '):'-')+
      '\n적용 우측 X/Y: '+(relay.effectiveAxes?relay.effectiveAxes.slice(2).map(v=>v.toFixed(2)).join(' / '):'-')+
      '\n거부 순서/형식: '+relay.rejectedSequence+' / '+relay.rejectedInvalid;
  }
}
